svg.text: First 10 primitive triples in a 0.01-radian wedge
center-of-mass frame; 0 ≤ t ≤ 4; ordinary DOP853 visualization
physical angle θ=2 arctan(u); displayed opening expanded to 70°
Actual opening: 0.01 rad = 0.572958°; radial coordinate = log₁₀(c)
normalized coordinates (initial c=1); line opacity 0.22; start dots opaque, terminal dots translucent
Visualization only: minimum sampled separation 2.87e-06; worst sampled relative energy drift 3.11e-06
